The Problem

Work has changed. Risk still follows people.

Attackers, data, and AI agents all reach your business through a person. The tools protecting them rarely connect.

Find your risk

  • AI enabled phishing

    of attacks start with an email. A supplier changes an invoice. The CFO asks for a transfer. Both are fake.

  • Data exfiltration

    8,000+

    copy-pastes and uploads are fed to shadow AI every hour, each tied to a person. Most don’t know they’re doing it.

  • Shadow AI

Our Mission

This is how your workforce stays protected

Customer PII, code your team wrote, and the records your business runs on. Three ways data leaks: attackers who steal it, employees who leave with it, and AI tools that share it instantly.

Discover. Govern. Protect. Resolve.
